listening.title: A Call with a Business Partner

lines.speaker: Mai (Office Staff)
lines.text: Hi Đức, thanks for taking my call. Do you have the call agenda I sent earlier?

lines.speaker: Đức (Partner)
lines.text: Yes, I have it open. Should we go through it point by point?

lines.speaker: Mai (Office Staff)
lines.text: Sure. First, I'd like to confirm details about the delivery date.

lines.speaker: Đức (Partner)
lines.text: The line quality is a bit bad right now — can you repeat that?

lines.speaker: Mai (Office Staff)
lines.text: I said I'd like to confirm details about the delivery date.

lines.speaker: Đức (Partner)
lines.text: Got it. Let me switch to speakerphone so my colleague can join too.

lines.speaker: Mai (Office Staff)
lines.text: No problem. Also, there's a time difference we should plan around for our next call.

lines.speaker: Đức (Partner)
lines.text: Good point. Maybe we should reschedule the call to a time that works for both offices.

lines.speaker: Mai (Office Staff)
lines.text: Agreed. Let's wrap up the call now and confirm a new time by email.

lines.speaker: Đức (Partner)
lines.text: Sounds good. I'll follow up with a follow-up call next week.
